propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing can normalize structurally divergent provider/model output to an empty result that appears valid but contains no usable verification entries
Semantically empty verifications (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty) must never produce a valid pass or valid empty review outcome
The decision layer already enforces indeterminate classification for any finding lacking a verification entry regardless of whether emptiness originated from provider silence or malformed response
Telemetry must distinctly count clean parses, recovered non-empty parses, semantically empty outcomes, and unrecoverable contract failures via outcome_counts buckets
Pipeline-level wiring of outcome_counts telemetry into live plan_review_decide and code_review_decide consumers remains incomplete and requires separate follow-up work
